highlights.description: Initial release of releasekit: release management toolkit for Go projects

added.description: releasekit CLI with validate, check, commits, status, modules commands
Language auto-detection for Go, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust
Pre-release validation framework with pluggable checkers
Go checker: build, test, lint (golangci-lint), mod tidy, coverage
TypeScript/JavaScript checker: build, test, lint via npm/yarn
Git operations: tag management, branch analysis, remote handling
Multi-agent-spec AgentResult output format for agent workflow interoperability
Multiple output formats: TOON (default), JSON, text
Dry-run mode for previewing validation commands
